# GemRun

> GemRun is a gamified running experience for iPhone (iOS 17+, currently in
> TestFlight beta). The system drops virtual gems on real, walkable streets;
> runners claim them by passing within 100 ft. Claims are GPS-verified
> server-side and first-come-first-served — one shared world, one winner per
> gem. Free to play, and runner data is stored on the phone first.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone only, iOS 17+ (TestFlight beta); no Android version
- Price: free to play; gems have no monetary value and cannot be bought or sold
- Gem rarity tiers: Quartz (Common), Emerald (Uncommon), Sapphire (Rare),
  Amethyst (Epic), Ember (Legendary — system-seeded only, never player-placed)
- Claim rule: pass within 100 ft of a gem; one winner per gem, settled
  atomically; every run's GPS track is replayed server-side with pace bounds,
  teleport detection and accuracy gating (fixes worse than 50 m cannot claim)
- Gameplay: the backend stocks the map around every player automatically;
  players also draw street-snapped routes and place gems from a distance-based
  budget; leaderboards, streak multipliers, themed gem sets, first-find crowns
- Tracking: distance, per-km splits, pace, elevation gain and estimated
  calories on every run; syncs with Apple Health on-device
- Privacy: local-first storage on the iPhone; Apple Health data is never
  uploaded; location permission is "While Using" only; the only data sent to
  the server is the claim-verification GPS track plus username and route best
  times for leaderboards
- Map data: © OpenStreetMap contributors, Open Database License (ODbL)
- Contact: hello@gemrun.app
